card.name: Inside words starting with hyper or pre
card.fires_on: The piece right after a prefix like hyper or pre in a medical word, most often the k in hyperkalemia. Also seen in hyperinfection and pre-treatment.

modes.label: Hyperkalemia
modes.description: The k that follows hyper, spelling out hyperkalemia in warnings and contraindications.

modes.label: Other prefixed words
modes.description: The piece after hyper or pre or re in other hyphenated or prefixed medical words.
